tickets.title: Review benefits enrollment options
tickets.text:
Use this checklist during benefits enrollment review for Rina Copperwisp's new benefits at Amber Teapot Pediatrics, with selections needed before the enrollment window closes:
- Confirm enrollment window and whether changes are new, annual, or life-event related.
- Compare medical plan premiums, deductibles, out-of-pocket maximums, network access, and prescription coverage.
- Review HSA or FSA eligibility, contribution limits, employer funding, and carryover rules.
- Check dental and vision coverage against expected needs.
- Review group life, disability, accident, critical illness, and supplemental insurance options.
- Confirm beneficiary designations for employer benefits and retirement plans.
- Note payroll deduction impact and any coordination needed with cash flow or tax planning.
- Identify follow-up documents or elections the client must complete through the benefits portal.

Rina can access the enrollment portal with her signed offer letter credentials. The portal presents medical, dental, vision, HSA, disability, and group life choices for the household to review.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to review the choices, dated 2023-11-24

tickets.title: Collect mortgage document packet
tickets.text:
Use this workflow to gather a complete mortgage document packet before analysis or submission for the Copperwisps' Asheville purchase file with Mossy Meteor Lending. Confirm the requested purpose, collect current loan and property documents, identify missing items, and prepare a clean packet for advisor review. Do not include real account numbers in the task notes; store sensitive documents only in the approved client file location.

Mossy Meteor Lending requested current mortgage, escrow, property tax, homeowners insurance, and asset documentation. The Portland townhouse mortgage has a 3.125% fixed rate with a $2,540 monthly payment including escrow, and the household has about $148,000 in checking and savings at Teacup Comet Bank (excluding the $30,000 earnest money deposit already paid).

subTasks.title: Confirm mortgage request scope
subTasks.text: Clarify whether the packet is for a new purchase, refinance, home equity review, payoff planning, or lender documentation request. Note required document categories and any relative timing expectations.

subTasks.title: Gather property and loan documents
subTasks.text: Request or locate the current mortgage statement, escrow statement if applicable, property tax bill, homeowners insurance declarations page, purchase or refinance closing disclosure if available, and any lender checklist provided by the client.

subTasks.title: Check packet for gaps
subTasks.text: Compare received documents against the requested checklist. Flag missing pages, outdated statements, mismatched property addresses, or unclear ownership information for follow-up.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor review summary
subTasks.text: Summarize loan type, rate structure, payment components, remaining term, escrow status, and open questions. Link the organized document packet in the secure file location.

tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to organize the packet before the lender’s next underwriting review, dated 2023-11-27

tickets.title: Escalate Teacup Comet Bank transfer limitation
tickets.text: Escalate the temporary online transfer limitation at Teacup Comet Bank so verified closing funds for the Copperwisps' Asheville home purchase can move without relying on mailed checks. The limitation was placed after the household used a forwarding address, and Elias Copperwisp wants the issue resolved before closing.
tickets.evidence: Elias wants the issue escalated so verified closing funds can move without relying on mailed checks; the agreed follow-up is dated 2023-12-01

tickets.title: Review financial plan assumptions and recommendations
tickets.text:
Review the Copperwisps' financial plan for current assumptions, retirement income needs, tax-aware investment considerations, rollover opportunities, cash flow changes, insurance gaps, estate planning coordination items, and next-step recommendations. Document evidence reviewed and summarize planning updates for the client conversation.

The existing plan still uses the Portland mortgage payment ($2,540/month at 3.125%), Oregon tax assumptions, and prior cash reserve target. Update for the new Asheville home purchase (planned mortgage of about $592,000 with expected payment of about $4,850/month), North Carolina tax assumptions, and relocation cash flow including Rina's new $118,000 salary at Amber Teapot Pediatrics.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to update the plan assumptions for the new home purchase and relocation cash flow, dated 2023-12-18

tickets.title: Review insurance policy coverage
tickets.text: Review the Copperwisps' Oregon-based insurance structure against the new Asheville, North Carolina property and household risk profile. The homeowners, auto, and umbrella policies are currently written through Silver Marmot Insurance for the Oregon residence and garaging location, and the move changes the insured residence, auto garaging location, and umbrella-policy underwriting details. Each spouse also carries $1,000,000 of term life insurance with policy terms running into their early sixties.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to review the Oregon-based policy structure against the new property and household risk profile, dated 2023-12-08

Clarify with payroll and the household's tax preparer so wage sourcing is correct for the Oregon-to-North Carolina move.

tickets.title: Coordinate household mailing address change
tickets.text: Coordinate the Copperwisps' mailing address change across advisory records, custodian profiles at Velvet Acorn Custody, tax form delivery settings, and routine service-provider records once the Asheville residence is usable for mail.
